title: A gap-research story's check counts a closing note only when it cites a tagged article fact
goal: the check a gap-research story carries counts a Resolved, Partly resolved, Narrowed or Closed note as closing only when the note cites a tagged article fact by path:line or a source id its article cites, so a closing on a code read or a local run with nothing behind it fails the item's done; the closings of 2026-10-21 backed by neither are re-read against the rule

run:
import glob, re, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import kbfacts
es = kbfacts.ledger_entries('public/_gaps.md')
kbfacts.link_entries(es)
SEG = re.compile(r'(?:^|\s)- (?=(?:Resolved|Partly resolved|Narrowed|Closed|Tried) 20)')
REF = re.compile(r'\b([a-z0-9-]+/[a-z0-9-]+\.md):(\d+)')
SID = re.compile(r'\bS-[a-z0-9]{8}\b|\bS\d{2,5}\b')
TAG = re.compile(r'\[(?:DOC|CODE|DER)\b')
art = {p[len('kb/public/'):]: open(p, encoding='utf-8').read() for p in glob.glob('kb/public/*/*.md')}
def tagged(p, n):
    L = art.get(p, '').split('\n')
    return 0 < int(n) <= len(L) and TAG.search(L[int(n) - 1])
bad = []
for e in es:
    tops = [t.split('/', 1)[1] + '.md' for t in (e['explicit'] or []) + (e['via_sources'] or [])]
    for seg in SEG.split(e['text'])[1:]:
        if not re.match(r'(?:Resolved|Partly resolved|Narrowed|Closed) 2026-10-2\d', seg):
            continue
        refs = REF.findall(seg)
        ok = (refs and all(tagged(p, n) for p, n in refs)) or (not refs and set(SID.findall(seg)) & set(SID.findall(' '.join(art.get(t, '') for t in tops))))
        if not ok:
            bad.append(e['line'])
            break
print(len(bad), 'gap entries with a 2026-10-2x closing note backed by no tagged article fact (path:line) and no source id its article cites', bad[:40])
sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)

import re, sys
s = open('skills/sprint/SKILL.md', encoding='utf-8').read()
i, j = s.find('## plan'), s.find('## start')
ok = re.search(r'(?i)(?:gap|closing)[^.]{0,300}path:line', s[i:j])
print('the plan step asks a gap-research check to read a cited fact by path:line:', bool(ok))
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

clauses.clause: the check a gap-research story carries counts a Resolved, Partly resolved, Narrowed or Closed note as closing only when the note cites a tagged article fact by path:line or a source id its article cites, so a closing on a code read or a local run with nothing behind it fails the item's done
the closings of 2026-10-21 backed by neither are re-read against the rule

notes: Retrospective of SP-5cyrnkw7 and SP-z6wolmvm (2026-10-22, operator accepted): the gap stories' checks counted any closing word as closed; the fresh reviews found 3 run-based closings in C (fixed by ST-5p46sliz) and 34 gitlab closings in D with no article fact or source row (fixed by ST-xfuucxk2). On origin/main of 2026-10-22 the draft check lists 213 closings dated 2026-10-2x across other domains that cite no article fact by path:line; many may cite source ids the article holds, so planning decides whether a cited source id counts. Operator 2026-10-22: a closing note is backed when it cites a tagged article fact by path:line or a source id its article cites. Premise on origin/main of 2026-10-22: check 0 lists 118 entries backed by neither; check 1 exits 1 (the plan step names no path:line rule).
